Thanks Rachel. Quick summary of next steps from Privacy Ops: 
1) Confirm roles: Redwood is acting as processor for Vertex Health (controller). We only remove model inputs/outputs and customer-scoped artifacts belonging to their workspace; Vertex remains responsible for directing the DSR and retaining proof on their side where applicable. We can, however, provide a deletion manifest and an audit extract.

2) Evidence we will provide (attached):
- deletion-manifest-vertexhealth-20260810.csv — lists internal object IDs, timestamps, and deletion job run IDs;
- redwood_deletion_audit_20260812.txt — audit of deletion process (job start/end, worker ids, checksum of wiped shards);
- signed_sccs_vertexhealth_2024.pdf — copy of SCCs executed (for contract context).

Notes and constraints: 
- Backups: our backup retention has a 30-day rolling snapshot for cold storage; deletions are applied against live stores and snapshots are pruned in the next scheduled snapshot rollover. We will include a statement of expected snapshot purge timing and a link to our retention policy excerpt.
- Logs: we cannot retroactively redact identifiers from system-wide analytics logs without significant engineering effort; we will provide an export of logs that contain the object IDs as evidence, and mark any entries that cannot be redacted.

Priyom — can you confirm whether Vertex wants a signed cover letter on Redwood letterhead and whether legal@vertexhealth.com should receive the evidence directly? If yes, we'll produce a short signed PDF.

I'll assemble the bundle and deliver by EOD Tuesday local time.

— Neha
Senior Privacy Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference
